name: 28319-longdecode-8b-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 on one a3 node (--gres=gpu:4).
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, one node, `mp` executor backend.
architecture: dense decoder (LlamaForCausalLM), 8.03B params in bf16, 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, context 131072. Full config on the checkpoint.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 256 streams, warmup the first 25% by completion, bounded at 1024 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. Streams are pinned at 256 and are not searched.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets. Every request is exactly 2048 prompt tokens and exactly 2048 output tokens (min = max on both), with ignore_eos set, so each one is 1 prefill followed by 2047 decode steps and context sweeps 2048 -> 4096.
purpose: An 8B-parameter report writer producing 2048-token narratives from 2048-token briefs for 256 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# vLLM at commit da786e339e985cbf32f43474e7b88b8da65c76e5 (`git describe` =
# v0.11.1rc5-201-gda786e339e9). Interpreter and hardware: configs/env.yaml, not portable.

# Ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, whose repo is gated. Same weights, same vocab.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 4
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
distributed-executor-backend: mp
dtype: bfloat16

# Pinned rather than left to resolve: unpinned they fall through to DEFAULT_MAX_NUM_SEQS = 128 and
# DEFAULT_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS = 2048, and 128 would silently serve half the declared 256 streams.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false
